# Brethof Voice Pro

> Offline desktop application for voice-to-text transcription and 38-language translation that runs entirely on local hardware without cloud connectivity.

Supports Linux x86_64 and Windows x64 via a portable binary or per-user installer. Features include file and microphone transcription, a voice keyboard, and LoRA fine-tuning for personal voice adaptation. The repository serves as a public issue tracker and documentation hub for this closed-source product.

## Docs

- [Brethof Voice Pro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-voice/main/README.md): Issue tracker, documentation hub, installation instructions, and links for the closed-source offline voice-to-text application.
